A '''tech dome''' was a type of garage or workshop that extended off houses on settlement worlds like [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The tech dome was used for conducting maintenance work on vehicles, [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and other equipment.<ref name="Giants">{{SWRadio|While Giants Mark Time}}</ref>
